response.sql: SELECT AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS avg_rebate_to_fee_ratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fees WHERE feerate >= 0.0009;

assumptions.assumption: The high fee-rate band includes the cutoff. The count includes all records in that band; AVG ignores missing rebate rates.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only high-band records with a nonmissing rebate rate.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS avg_rebate_to_fee_ratio, COUNT(rebrate) AS record_count FROM fees WHERE feerate >= 0.0009;
SELECT AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS avg_rebate_to_fee_ratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fees WHERE feerate > 0.0009;
